cim: Local high school students learn about artificial intelligence during Rotary Club World Affairs Conference
cim_eredeti: Local high school students learn about artificial intelligence during Rotary Club World Affairs Conference
szoveg_eredeti:
FORT WAYNE, Ind. (WPTA) - The Rotary Club World Affairs Conference was held in Fort Wayne on Tuesday.

Hundreds of high school students from across 21Country gathered at Purdue Fort Wayne to learn about artificial intelligence (AI).

The conference included an interactive two-part activity showing students how to design, test, brand, and market using the technology, as well as speakers who discussed how AI is shaping education and the workforce.

Organizers say the conference provides students an opportunity to rasie awareness to global issues through critical thinking, communication, collaboration, problem-solving, conflict and sustainability resolution, and leadership.
